standard_prerequisites.name: Right adjoints of exact functors preserve injectives
standard_prerequisites.statement: If a functor is a right adjoint of an exact functor, it preserves injectives and K-injectives (Homology and Derived Categories, declared as tagged source pointers).
standard_prerequisites.use: It gives parts (1)(b) and (2)(b) at source lines 823-828.

standard_prerequisites.name: The lower shriek adjunction and its exactness
standard_prerequisites.statement: The functor i_{f,!} is a left adjoint of i_f^{-1}, constructed for sheaves of sets and abelian sheaves, and it is exact (Topologies and Modules on Sites, declared as tagged source pointers).
standard_prerequisites.use: It is the first proof of parts (1)(a) and (2)(a) at source lines 831-838.

standard_prerequisites.name: Factorization of i_f through the small site and localization
standard_prerequisites.statement: i_f = i_Y o f_{big}, and f_{big} is a localization so pullback by it preserves injectives and K-injectives (Topologies and Cohomology on Sites, declared as tagged source pointers).
standard_prerequisites.use: It is the second proof of parts (1)(a) and (2)(a) at source lines 839-846.

standard_prerequisites.name: The failure for modules
standard_prerequisites.statement: The analogous statements for modules of O-modules fail, as shown by an explicit counterexample (Etale Cohomology, declared as a tagged source pointer).
standard_prerequisites.use: It is the closing remark of the statement and proof at source lines 819 and 848-850.

core_obligations: Parts (1)(b) and (2)(b): the restriction to the small site is a right adjoint of the exact functor pi_X^{-1}, so it preserves injectives and K-injectives (source lines 822-828).
First proof of (1)(a) and (2)(a): i_f^{-1} is a right adjoint of the exact functor i_{f,!} (source lines 830-838).

Second proof of (1)(a) and (2)(a): factor i_f = i_Y o f_{big}, use that localization pullback preserves injectives and K-injectives, then apply the already proved parts to i_Y^{-1} (source lines 839-846).
Counterexample for modules: refer to the Etale Cohomology statement (source lines 848-850).

proof_roadmap.step: Parts (b) by adjunction with the exact restriction pullback.
First proof of parts (a) via the lower shriek adjunction.
Second proof of parts (a) via i_f = i_Y o f_{big} and localization.

difficulty_reason: The counted unit is the author's own lemma lemma-compare-injectives at source lines 799-820: for a morphism Y -> X of the big etale site, injectives of Ab((Spaces/X)_etale) restrict to injectives both on Y_etale and on X_etale, and the same holds for K-injective complexes, while the corresponding statements for modules fail. The author's proof at source lines 822-851 proves parts (1)(b) and (2)(b) formally from the fact that the restriction functor is a right adjoint of an exact functor (two cross-chapter pointers), then proves parts (1)(a) and (2)(a) in two independent ways: first by exhibiting i_f^{-1} as a right adjoint of the exact functor i_{f,!} (three cross-chapter pointers), and second by factoring i_f = i_Y o f_{big}, using that f_{big} is a localization and hence preserves injectives and K-injectives (two more pointers) and applying the already proved parts. It closes by referring to a counterexample for modules (a further pointer). All cited inputs are outside the chapter and each is declared as a tagged source pointer; the two independent proofs of the substantive parts are both reproduced.
